#
# It is WRONG for CURRENT-VALUE content. Tested: a status row merges to
# both `Decided` and `Rejected`; a version header appears twice; and a
# union-duplicated CLAUDE.md slices identically to a clean one, so
# shared-core-hash PASSES on a file holding two full copies of the rules.
# Later rules win, so these fall back to the default 3-way merge, which
# writes visible conflict markers — failing closed, not open.
docs/v1/**/*.md      merge=text
docs/Modular_PRD.md  merge=text
CLAUDE.md            merge=text
AGENTS.md            merge=text
.agents/**/*.md      merge=text

> ⛔ **`C-33` — this DoD phrase is NOT yet earned (`D-118`, raised by Lane B as `B-044`).** `0002` is
> drafted at `d826b53` and its test **asserts on migration TEXT**: it never starts PostgreSQL,
> applies `0001` then `0002`, invokes the trigger, or observes a rollback. **A text assertion stays
> green while the SQL is syntactically invalid.** **Two unverified things are held apart**: `DEP-05`
> permits **live anon-key** behaviour to remain unverified; a **local PostgreSQL** unit test needs no
> credentials and is still required. `C-33` carries the eight-case contract.

**Closes when a disposable PostgreSQL runs `0001` then `0002` and those eight behave**, with the
report reading *"local PostgreSQL unit-tested; live Supabase anon-key behaviour unverified"*.
**Lane B's surface, Lane B's work** — and it may need a dependency, which is Lane A's to provision
(`D-86`).

> **`C-14` travels with this item (`D-58`).** `G11`'s detection half — the shared-core hash, the `D-54` tier sweep, the §5.1 duplicate scan, and `missing.js` — is verification apparatus and waits on the same guardrail. **Precedence without detection is inert:** git here has one identity and zero merges, so a conflicting edit is a silent overwrite that nothing announces.
`merge7.js` is the reference merge script (repo-relative; `merge6.js` is retained for history but hard-codes an absolute path). `missing.js` reports which docs are absent from the graph.
